class.name: TamaAnimatedTexture
class.brief_description: A Resource that holds an animation strip of [Texture2D] frames with playback speed and blend mode.
class.description:
[b]TamaAnimatedTexture[/b] is the texture type used by all server object configs ([TamaServerBulletConfig], [TamaServerStraightLaserConfig], [TamaServerCurvedLaserConfig]). It stores a sequence of [Texture2D] frames, a playback speed, and a blend mode that is applied to the canvas item that draws the object type.
[b]Frames[/b] are indexed 0 to [member frame_count]−1. Each frame has a texture and an integer duration in animation-frames at the configured [member fps]. A [code]TamaAnimatedTexture[/code] with a single frame (or [member fps] ≤ 0) acts as a static texture.
[b]Blend mode[/b] controls how the rendered pixels are composited. It mirrors [enum CanvasItemMaterial.BlendMode] and is applied per object type, so all active objects of that type share the same blend mode.

members.member: Animation playback speed in frames per second. Each frame's integer [code]duration[/code] property specifies how many animation frames it is shown before advancing to the next. Set to [code]0[/code] or less to disable animation regardless of frame count.

Total number of frames. Changing this value adds or removes [code]frame_N/texture[/code] and [code]frame_N/duration[/code] properties in the inspector. Set to [code]1[/code] for a static (non-animated) texture.
Blend mode used when rendering objects of this type. Mirrors [enum CanvasItemMaterial.BlendMode]. All active objects that share this texture use the same blend mode.

constants.constant: Standard alpha blending. Equivalent to [constant CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_MIX].
Additive blending — the texture's colour is added to the background. Good for glows and energy effects. Equivalent to [constant CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD].
Subtractive blending — the texture's colour is subtracted from the background. Equivalent to [constant CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_SUB].
Multiply blending — darkens according to the texture's colour. Equivalent to [constant CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_MUL].
